text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Black line: meter reading. Shaded band: q05 to q95 of the forecast made 24 to 48 hours earlier. Line: its median. Events were chosen by a rule fixed before any was inspected (deepest and longest at D5, D14, and D16; most rows with a lagged reading inside the event). Each panel runs from 1 day before the event to 7 days after its end.'
